import json,random,subprocess,sys,os,hashlib

outs=[]
for seed in ['0','1','2','12345','random']:
 env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONHASHSEED=seed)
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/launch.py','/workspace/project'],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,cwd='/workspace')
